I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team: "Thanks, Pree. Correction noted: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. Dock 23 is superseded."

Gate 47 is now the site on record. My earlier "Dock 23" reply is still in the thread on her first message; I left it as it was.
